verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents prompt caching, which reuses work when requests share the same prompt prefix and bills reused tokens at a cached-input rate discounted up to 90%. The pricing page publishes per-model cached-input and cache-write prices, and the rate-limits guide explains how cached tokens interact with TPM limits. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the latency reduction (only implied by 'reuses work'), independent or hands-on corroboration of real savings.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can cut cost and latency on repeated context with documented prompt/prefix caching and its pricing

citations.quote: Prompt caching reuses work when requests share the same prompt prefix.
Pay the model's reduced cached-input rate for reused tokens, discounted up to 90%.
a standard-pricing table of short/long-context input, cached input, cache writes, and output prices per model
Cached input tokens still count toward tokens-per-minute limits
